title: The Happiest Reading Day
traveler_why: Scout is the Traveler who seeks out treasure and can't wait to share it, and tonight the whole city hears Heavenly Father's words read aloud and celebrates by sharing food with everyone: Scout runs home from preschool to teach the family a happy new song about Heavenly Father.
traveler_about: Scout fits tonight because Scout loves to discover treasure and share it. In Scout’s world today: at preschool, Scout learned a happy new song about Heavenly Father and could hardly wait to share it. Scout ran home, calling, “Listen! I learned something wonderful!” and taught it to the whole family. Just like the people who found joy in Heavenly Father’s words, Scout discovered that the best things are even better when we share them.
